sql: SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips AS trips, y.avg_total_amount AS avg_total_amount, y.avg_trip_distance AS avg_trip_distance, CASE WHEN y.trips IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_null_trips, CASE WHEN ABS(y.trips - AVG(y.trips) OVER ()) > 3 * STDDEV(y.trips) OVER () THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_outlier FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date WHERE d.d_dow = 4 AND y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
